# Bike Commute Notes

Notes on the commute I rode from January to April.

## Route

The route is 9 km each way along the river path, with one hill near the office. It takes about 28 minutes in the morning and 32 in the evening because of the headwind.

## Tires

I switched to 32 mm tires in March and the ride got noticeably smoother. The old 25 mm tires picked up two flats in February on the gravel section by the bridge.

## Lights

The front light is a 600 lumen unit charged over USB every third day. The rear light runs on two AAA batteries and lasts about a month.
